statement.p: Gail is conducting market research on the cost of a touchscreen laptop computer. Gail has determined that the average cost of a touchscreen laptop computer is 1210, and that the distribution of costs is normally distributed with a standard deviation of 126.
a. Find the probability that a single randomly selected consumer spends more than 1320 on a touchscreen laptop computer.
b. The cost of the middle 50 of touchscreen laptop computers falls between (round to the nearest dollar):
c. The most expensive 12 of touchscreen laptop computers cost at least how much? (round to the nearest dollar)
